task.title: Change a person
task.shortdesc: Correct a name, a date or a place on a person's page.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the page and choose .

stepresult.p: The page turns into a form. The names and the sex are on the left. The dates and places of birth and death are on the right. The form may open part of the way down: scroll up to see the top.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the form. Choose to keep your changes, or to leave the form as it was.

result.p: Your changes are saved to the file as you go. The page shows the new words.
result.note: The button sits below . It removes the person. Check before you choose it.
